<function name="StartEngineSchedule" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<description>Called by the engine only whenever <page>NPC:SetSchedule</page> is called. 
<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>
</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="scheduleID" type="number">Schedule ID to start. See <page>Enums/SCHED</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>
